plain: A mix of events that creates a critical moment.

webster.text: A joining; a combination or union, as of causes, events or circumstances; as an unhappy conjuncture of affairs.

example.quote: We should then always have a large number of men capable of serving their country in any dangerous conjuncture.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, New York Convention, June 23, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
